predecessors.name: Province of Quebec
predecessors.text: the eastern part of the Province of Quebec, with Labrador

successors.name: Province of Canada
successors.text: the Saint Lawrence valley of Quebec: Lower Canada east of the Ottawa River

ledger.x: 1841: Lower Canada is united with Upper Canada.
1841: the colony is dissolved on 10 February 1841; its territory becomes Canada East.

wars.name: Lower Canada Rebellion
wars.outcome: Rebellions in 1837-38; 'the 1791 Constitution was suspended on 27 March 1838'; no territory changed hands.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary survey; the border with the United States and with New Brunswick (Maine) was disputed (Webster-Ashburton is not on the page) and the northern limit of the province was never fixed.
